Great tasting wings
Oct 2017 • Solo
Stopped in while walking past and saw the guy cooking his wings and chicken feet, and I couldn't resist. Quite few locals eating there, I was happy to join in. Non English speaking staff, but that just makes it more authentic. Had 4 wings and 4 feet, and 3 tiger beers, which luckily were very cold. Beautiful tasting authentic Vietnamese food, crunchy feet, and juicy wings. All for 125000 vnd. I could of eaten more. Special thanks to the young girl serving me, took her time to listen to my broken and limited Vietnamese. Just lost a point on the toilet, which is just about the normal in Vietnam.

Superb Chicken, okay environment
Jul 2016 • Solo
Chicken wings are superb! They are priced at 15k VND a piece. The chicken feet are 5k and are literally just the claw. 

Wings have crispy skin and is incredibly tender. These are must buys here

Grilled beef, not the best, kinda tough though the sauces were nice. Stick to the chicken.

As said,the napkins are just square pieces of thin tracing paper and not actual tissue. Small chairs and plastic stools make for an okay environment. 

Menu is okay, grilled stuff is the order of the day here!
